## Open questions

**Family retired by Daniel on 2026-09-04.** The entries below are preserved as
historical evidence or unanswered questions, not an active research queue.
See the [retirement decision](../gravity-as-scarcity/retirement.md).

Unpaid items the program still carries. The program section keeps the full prose.

- **Existence of a regular moving solution** — the live front (`closed-system-moving-existence`). No globally smooth non-cavitating settled flow is yet an excitation medium at solar-system winds.
- **Cavitation floor** — the trough cavitates at U/v_GP = 0.3. Either a floor mechanism is missing from the shear law or the excitation reading dies around slowly moving masses.
- **What is U locally** — still coupled to the galactic-carrier question; the sourced walls exist, the PPN reduction is algebra, the comparison awaits far-field slot coefficients.
